SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 27, 2022 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the COVID-19 pandemic and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the City Council Chamber will be open to the public. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, and N-08-21, and subsequently by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021) and City Council Resolution No. 2022-10 adopted pursuant thereto, this meeting may also be conducted via teleconference, if necessary. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in-person in the Council Chamber subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT HELD ON APRIL 27,
2022, 7:00 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Jeff Luddington, Generations Church.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Cub Scout Pack 72.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in
  attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

5.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Ren Sabio, pastor at New Hope Community Church, offered a prayer for
  Councilmember Elect Lynda Johnson.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments.

6.  Mayor’s Welcome and Introductions

  Mayor Hu introduced dignitaries in attendance. Each Councilmember, the Mayor
  Pro Tem, and the Mayor introduced their family and guests in attendance.

7.  Recognition of outgoing Councilmembers and Mayor

  Presentations were made to outgoing Mayor Grace Hu. A video was displayed
  highlighting Mayor Hu’s years of service.

8.  Installation of newly elected Councilmembers

  City Clerk Vida Barone administered the Oath of Office to newly elected
  Council/Agency member Frank Yokoyama.

  Los Angeles County Sheriff Alex Villanueva administered the Oath of Office to
  newly elected Council/Agency member Lynda P. Johnson.
 City of Cerritos  Wednesday, April 27, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting  Page 2 of 3

8.  Installation of newly elected Councilmembers (continued)

  The Council/Agency members were seated as follows:

  Council/Agency Member Bruce Barrows
  Council/Agency Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Chuong Vo
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama

9.  Annual Mayoral Transition (Selection of Mayor and Mayor Pro Tem)

  Vida Barone, City Clerk, declared the office of Mayor/Chair vacant and called for
  nominations for the office of Mayor/Chair.

  Council/Agency Member Barrows nominated Council/Agency Member Vo for the
  office of Mayor/Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, the City Clerk declared nominations
  closed.

  MOTION: As nominated by Council/Agency Member Barrows, Council/Agency Member
  Vo, was presented for consideration as Mayor/Chair.

  The motion carried (4 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Johnson, Solanki, Vo
  NOES:  Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Vo elected to the office of
  Mayor/Chair by acclamation.

  The office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair was declared vacant by Mayor/Chair Vo and
  he called for nominations for the office of Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  Mayor Vo nominated Council/Agency Member Barrows for the office of Mayor Pro
  Tem/Vice Chair.

  Noting there were no further nominations, Mayor/Chair Vo declared nominations
  closed.

  MOTION: As nominated by Mayor/Chair Vo, Council/Agency Member Barrows was
  presented for consideration as Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair.

  The motion carried (4 - 1) as follows:

  AYES:  Barrows, Johnson, Solanki, Vo
  NOES:  Yokoyama
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  The City Clerk declared Council/Agency Member Barrows elected to the office of
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair by acclamation.
 City of Cerritos  Wednesday, April 27, 2022, 7:00 p.m.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting  Page 3 of 3

10.  Closing Comments (Mayor, Mayor Pro Tem, and Councilmembers)

  Comments were made by Councilmembers Yokoyama, Johnson, and Solanki,
  Mayor Pro Tem Barrows, and Mayor Vo.

  Mayor/Chair Vo invited the community to a reception at the Cerritos Center for the
  Performing Arts.

15.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 9:11 p.m.

  /s/ Vida Barone_____________________
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
